description: Upgrades a MongoDB replica set through sequential FCV hops. Upgrades secondaries first, then steps down and upgrades the primary. setFeatureCompatibilityVersion is the point of no return.

target_version.label: Target Version
target_version.description: Target MongoDB version (e.g. 7.0). Multi-hop upgrades executed automatically.

rs_members.label: RS Members
rs_members.description: List of {host, port, priority}. High priority = primary.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight checks only — no changes applied

rollback.description: Before setFeatureCompatibilityVersion: restore mongodump archive and reinstall old binaries. After FCV set: irreversible per MongoDB docs. Rollback surfaces this clearly.

steps.description: rs.status() all members healthy, compute FCV hop chain
Per FCV hop: upgrade secondaries → stepdown primary → upgrade old primary → wait election → setFCV (POINT OF NO RETURN)
getParameter featureCompatibilityVersion matches target on all members
